material_recovery.law: interpolate two causal released estimates; positive common free-mode rate; unmodified PANN unilateral solve with bounded positive contact gain at first cross-foot reload
material_recovery.fit_target: measured whole-foot resultant, other footprint cells predicted by contemporaneous M1; no true cell force or true internal strain in fit
material_recovery.scope: One identified released anchor per saved footprint; short prediction explicitly rescored through the remaining measured 5kHz boundary. Non-cross-foot and loaded-only paths retain M1.
material_recovery.acceptance: per B recording: improve cross-foot whole force and cell force, preserve preload depth and original short-force allowance 0.1*abs(M0-M1)

model_recipe.starts: half uniform unique, half touch/bearing/request; cross-case duplicates removed
model_recipe.fixed_whole_episode_validation: case B historical model development; deterministic 4096 evenly spaced starts across eligible unique case-B intervals
model_recipe.advance: 10000 vs 5000, 30000 vs 10000: strict improvement in both common validation loss and Brier, otherwise stop each seed/structure separately; 50000 terminal
model_recipe.operator: structured uses known current articulated 18x25 inverse dynamic map frozen across 7-step training window, total constrained held PD, learned actual contact impulse and acceleration residual; neither variant uses future real requests

model_freeze.fixed_day_recipe: 64 candidates twice; first request held to its next model-predicted legal event; later nominal requests.
model_freeze.selector: longest registered horizon with real ranking above the replay floor and no excess hard failure; shortest registered node if all models lack physical support

real_E60.production_observer: CPU FP64 frozen potentials; central finite-difference Newton

normal_video_entry.scope: Full recorded robot trajectory, visual-only strip overlay; no new integration or exaggerated deformation

material_packets.source: 12 registered W59 B3 development legal-request snapshots, one real 10x0.2 ms observer window each. Empty-material windows stay in the denominator. Timings are warm medians over five calls.
material_packets.scope: The existing CPU/CUDA forecast pair gets identical initial e/q, observed position histories and constant mean physical dt. It returns state, peak strain and residual. Production CPU additionally uses per-tick measured dt, load trace, forces and the M1 assimilation correction. The CUDA operator does not implement that full ABI.
material_packets.GPU_timing: Warm context, resident weights and preallocated output. Includes copying packet data to device and results to CPU. Python state construction excluded from both sides.
material_packets.run_device: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition

hardware.name: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition

paired_shared_gpu_samples.scope: Device-wide 30 s samples during the overlapping A/B workload; includes other jobs.

m1_hybrid.registration: Twelve W59 development snapshots and two completed 5902 PPO-full fallback E60 recordings, A/B 0021. No policy or model was fitted.
m1_hybrid.offline_schedule: Single-worker A then B on CPU 19 for the initial layout. Matched 12-snapshot layout selection. Final A and B each alternate CPU/GPU on identical real inputs and run together on CPUs 19 and 20. Original extra physics slots used: zero. Math threads: one per worker. GPU shared.
m1_hybrid.recording_layout: In the W59 measurement Release asset, inputs/<case>-inputs.npz provides every original substep start/end, sole bottom positions, sole velocities and physical contact flags. paired-workers/<case>-packets.npz stores actual_Fz and is_material on the same clocks. The query JSON contains every original query time, four xy positions, archived and both recomputed heights. The input folder also contains the original plant and controller contact ledgers.
m1_hybrid.physical_event_comparison: Exact 0.2 ms right-boundary tick, global world-cell key, event kind and leg. Cross-foot lineage additionally requires the preceding load on the same key at the same tick and with the same previous foot.
m1_hybrid.projection_scope: Each underlying recorded E60 keeps its own original plant, controller and I/O time. Only its measured observation and recovery query times are scaled using matching paired internal timers. This estimates a possible online wall change; the plant and the live policy were not rerun.

six_slot_comparison.scope: Two 240 s natural scratch windows. Interpolated at common absolute wall boundaries from actual plant clock publications. The four incumbent PIDs/attempts did not change. New tasks are the already registered recovered-A cases. Different contact phases and external workload remain visible.

material_traversal.measurement: First outbound base-projection passage from the west to east strip boundary without a side exit, with actual material-loaded feet during that passage. Uses original strip geometry and500Hz recorded states; no extra physical termination threshold or route change.

interpretation_guards: All six model members trained to 50000; reported long-rollout development_force_error and frozen action assessment used 10000. Long-rollout failure at 10000 is not evidence of failure at 50000.
r3_gradient_test_substeps=0 means no qualified gradient horizon was selected, not measured gradient accuracy zero.
M3 fits three released-cell recovery parameters on 67 event rows. Offline acceptance is not physical closed-loop acceptance or material-family adaptation.
Six-slot total throughput gains are 65.029951% and 57.346944%; 1.899505% and 1.137098% are the original four incumbent streams only.
GPU hybrid observer 1.626119x is matched offline replay, with no new physics and no production backend change; full E60 1.16-1.18x values are projections.
Current WBC already has nonlinear-model M,h,J,Jdotv and floating-base dynamics constraints. Adding these equations is not a new contribution.
Source-code explanations for model instability are hypotheses pending controlled ablations.
Residual MPC 100 Hz describes simulated policy/control schedule. 1000 environments require about 0.5 s wall clock per simulation step in the read preprint.

papers.title: Fully data-driven inverse characterization of heterogeneous materials with hyper-network neural ODEs
papers.read_scope: Official full PDF downloaded; Methods equations 9–19, model architecture, field interpolation, loss/training stages, synthetic and printed-specimen experiments, Discussion. Static source read utils_hyperelasticity.py and repo tree; no replication.
papers.limits: Hyperelastic field identification from full-field displacement; NODE depth is not physical relaxation time; cannot import as proven viscoelastic online estimator.

papers.title: History-Aware Neural Operator: Robust Data-Driven Constitutive Modeling of Path-Dependent Materials
papers.read_scope: Full PDF, architecture/training Section 3, comparison Section 4, history-length Section 5.4, limitations Section 6. No official code reproduction.
papers.limits: Observable stress/strain histories and scheduled autoregression useful; no universal history length or universal thermodynamic certificate. Formal journal metadata not used without fresh verification.

papers.title: Residual MPC: Blending Reinforcement Learning With GPU-Parallelized Model Predictive Control
papers.read_scope: Author preprint full PDF and HTML: Sections III–V, Alg.1–2, Tables I–II, hardware paragraph and limitations. Formal 2026 venue/date verified on IEEE and author page; no claim that final 20-page version was fully read.
papers.limits: CusADi public core is not verified complete Residual MPC stack, nor automatic torch backward. 100Hz control discretization is not 100Hz wall-clock batch throughput.

papers.title: Variance-Reduced Model Predictive Path Integral via Quadratic Model Approximation
papers.read_scope: Full PDF downloaded; Sections II–IV, Algorithm1, quadratic proposal and importance correction, Hessian approximations, static/cart-pole/contact experiments and TableII.
papers.limits: Contact example model construction about 1412 ms + sample computation706 ms; not proof of real-time quadruped operation. Count auxiliary smoothing samples and curvature time.

papers.title: Robot Tracking Control With Natural Task-Space Decoupling
papers.read_scope: Official full PDF; Sections II–IV and VI–VIII, assumptions, desired block-diagonal inertia, Coriolis consistency, passivity/tracking proof conditions, simulations and Rollin Justin hardware.
papers.limits: Fully actuated locally invertible task map; cannot directly transplant proof to underactuated floating base with soft switching contact. Hardware force observer lacked independent ground-truth force validation.

papers.title: Sampling-based Model Predictive Control Using Trust Regions
papers.venue: Accepted CDC 2026 per current arXiv metadata
papers.read_scope: Full PDF; Sections II–VI, dual eta/alpha, importance weights, Gaussian projection, deterministic Gaussian samples, buffer/warmstart, experiments/timings.
papers.limits: KL/entropy distribution optimization worth a strong comparison; finite-sample projection is approximate, and reported cart-pole/truck timings are not kilohertz.
